name: researchos
description: Connect GPT to the local ResearchOS research library through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Read and write your local research workspace.
interface.longDescription: ResearchOS connects GPT to your local research questions, paper cards, evidence, and Markdown drafts. Reads stay local until a tool is used; write tools are explicit and auditable.
defaultPrompt: 总结我的 ResearchOS 工作区，并建议今天最值得推进的一步。
检索与当前研究问题相关的论文卡片和证据。
把这段回答追加到我指定的 Markdown 文稿。
